installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PortWatcher (PortWatch VI Discord bot) - Pterodactyl install script.
# Downloads the static Linux binary for this server's CPU from the GitHub releases.
set -euo pipefail

REPO="wildesPepega/portwatch-vi-discord-bot"
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64) ARCH="x86_64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH="aarch64" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${RELEASE_VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${RELEASE_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download"
else
  BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${RELEASE_VERSION}"
fi

echo "Downloading portwatch-bot (${ARCH}) from ${BASE}"
curl -fsSL -o portwatch-bot "${BASE}/portwatch-bot-${ARCH}-linux"
curl -fsSL -o portwatch-bot.sha256 "${BASE}/portwatch-bot-${ARCH}-linux.sha256"
echo "$(cut -d' ' -f1 portwatch-bot.sha256)  portwatch-bot" | sha256sum -c -
rm -f portwatch-bot.sha256
chmod +x portwatch-bot
mkdir -p data

echo "Install complete. Set DISCORD_TOKEN on the Startup tab, then start the server."
